bug_semantics: The /api/asset/getFileAnnotation endpoint returns the .sya PDF-annotation file (highlights and notes) for any asset path the caller supplies, but the route is registered with only model.CheckAuth — unlike the /assets/* raw-file route, which enforces publish access and publish password. An anonymous reader (when publish authentication is disabled) or any publish RoleReader who knows or guesses an asset path can therefore read the PDF annotations of publish-forbidden, password-protected, or unpublished documents in non-encrypted notebooks (CWE-862 Missing Authorization).
flaw_origin: Commit f40ed985e10b0f8391d6c94367cc85b9b5fad6bd ("完整开源界面和内核" [#5013], 2022-05-26, author Liang Ding <845765@qq.com>) introduced both the getFileAnnotation handler in kernel/api/asset.go and its router registration `ginServer.Handle("POST", "/api/asset/getFileAnnotation", model.CheckAuth, getFileAnnotation)` in kernel/api/router.go (still present verbatim at v3.7.2 line 342 and HEAD line 375). The handler reads any .sya under the workspace with only CheckAuth gating; no publish-access check existed anywhere in the codebase until 2026 (publish service came later in ba2193403da7, 2024-06-12). Parent tree of f40ed985 (the initial full open-source snapshot) lacks the endpoint entirely, so the BIC is the origin of the under-authorized route.
